fields.Name: T215 - AI Agent Requests Section
fields.Description: Opens the AI app's Agent Requests section and verifies it renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K box). The AI app's LEFT nav lists sections: Overview, Agents, Agent Requests, Prompts, Models, MCP, Analytics, Configuration. Click the 'Agent Requests' section in the left nav. Verify the Agent Requests view renders — a list/grid of agent requests, or a clearly-labeled empty state — with no error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI app's 'Agent Requests' section was opened
The view rendered (a list/grid of agent requests or a clear empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
